scope: Single consenting self-test plus fictional DigiFace distractors; no bulk staff enrollment
regression_checks: Continuous frames 1.25 seconds apart collect three accepted samples on one head
Good crops survive intervening poor-quality frames within the 30-second window
Identical settings do not clear accepted samples
A valid in-flight crop may join enrollment during later blur without publishing a stale identity
Long head gaps, changed tracks/settings and ambiguous scenes still invalidate capture
Single-photo quality, consent, size and one-profile constraints remain enforced
Qdrant registration failure rolls back the local enrollment

browser.source: Changing synthetic webcam fixture with real ONNX models

rtsp.source: Local synthetic H.264/TCP feed via MediaMTX

limits: This is regression validation with 256 synthetic distractors, not a rerun of the full 109619-identity benchmark
Physical Ubuntu webcam and the developer's exact symptom have not been reproduced on his machine
No GPU performance or real-person false-match-rate claim
One existing Starlette/httpx deprecation warning; no test failures
Current Ubuntu source-test CI results are linked from PR 4; model assets are not installed in CI
